study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Floris et al., Biological Psychiatry: Cognitive Neuroscience and Neuroimaging, 2021
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Atypical Brain Asymmetry in Autism - A Candidate for Clinically Meaningful Stratification

nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: we estimated a normative brain aging model at each gray matter laterality voxel by using Gaussian process regression (53), a Bayesian nonparametric interpolation method

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Voxelwise gray matter laterality index derived from VBM-processed T1-weighted images.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: A laterality index was calculated at each voxel using the following formula: 2(Inref - I ref )/(I nref + I ref ). ... we estimated a normative brain aging model at each gray matter laterality voxel

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age, sex, and site were used as covariates in the normative model.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: we trained a Gaussian process regression model at each voxel on the neurotypical cohort using age, sex, and site as covariates to predict gray matter asymmetry
